--!strict
--[[
    Stylized — TopbarPlus (Icon) styling utility.

    External dependencies:
      • TopbarPlus `Icon` module (set ICON_MODULE below).
      • script.Assets.Sounds  — Sound instances: Click, Selected, Deselected, View.
      • script.Styles.Glow    — a "GlowFrame" template holding a "Glow" UIGradient.
]]

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService      = game:GetService("TweenService")
local SoundService      = game:GetService("SoundService")
local StarterGui        = game:GetService("StarterGui")

local ICON_MODULE = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Client"):WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("Packages").Icon
local Icon = require(ICON_MODULE)

local Assets = script.Assets
local Sounds = Assets.Sounds
local Styles = script.Styles

local GlowStyle = Styles.Glow

local Config = {
	Sounds = {
		Click      = Sounds.Click,
		Selected   = Sounds.Selected,
		Deselected = Sounds.Deselected,
		View       = Sounds.View,
	},
	SoundVolume = 0.5,
}

-- Internal helpers ----------------------------------------------------------
local function playSound(soundId: (number | string)?, volume: number?)
	if not soundId or soundId == 0 then return end
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.SoundId = if typeof(soundId) == "number" then ("rbxassetid://" .. soundId) else soundId :: string
	sound.Volume = volume or Config.SoundVolume
	sound.Parent = SoundService
	sound:Play()
	sound.Ended:Once(function()
		sound:Destroy()
	end)
	-- safety cleanup in case Ended never fires (bad id, etc.)
	task.delay(10, function()
		if sound and sound.Parent then
			sound:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

local function createGlowFrame(glowColor: Color3?): Frame
	local GlowFrame = GlowStyle.GlowFrame:Clone()
	local GlowColor = GlowFrame.Glow

	GlowColor.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, glowColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(0, 0, 0)),
	})

	return GlowFrame
end

-- Themes --------------------------------------------------------------------
local listTheme = {
	{"Widget", "BorderSize", 5},
	{"Dropdown", "BackgroundTransparency", 1},
	{"Dropdown", "MaxIcons", 4},

	{"DropdownScroller", "ScrollBarThickness", 5},
	{"DropdownScroller", "ScrollBarImageColor3", Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)},
	{"DropdownScroller", "ScrollBarImageTransparency", 0.28},

	{"DropdownList", "Padding", UDim.new(0, 2)},
	{"DropdownPadding", "PaddingTop", UDim.new(0, 2)},
	{"DropdownPadding", "PaddingRight", UDim.new(0, 15)},
	{"DropdownPadding", "PaddingBottom", UDim.new(0, 5)},

	{"Selection", "RotationSpeed", 4},
	{"SelectionGradient", "Color", ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)),
	})},
}

local childTheme = {
	{"Widget", "BorderSize", 2.5},
	{"Widget", "MinimumWidth", 160},
	{"Widget", "MinimumHeight", 40},

	{"IconButton", "BackgroundTransparency", 0.18},
	{"IconOverlay", "BackgroundTransparency", .9},
	{"IconCorners", "CornerRadius", UDim.new(1, 0)},
	{"IconSpot", "BackgroundTransparency", 1},
	{"IconImageScale", "Value", .8},

	{"IconLabel", "TextSize", 16},
	{"IconLabel", "Font", Enum.Font.SourceSansSemibold},

	{"PaddingLeft", "Size", UDim2.fromOffset(3, 0)},
	{"PaddingRight", "Size", UDim2.fromOffset(25, 0)},

	{"Notice", "Position", UDim2.new(1, -25, 0, 6)},
	{"ContentsList", "HorizontalAlignment", Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left},
}

-- Module --------------------------------------------------------------------
local Stylized = {}

function Stylized:newList(): (Icon.Icon, {any}, {any})
	local newList = Icon.new()
	newList:modifyTheme(listTheme)
	newList:modifyChildTheme(childTheme)
	return newList, listTheme, childTheme
end

function Stylized:setChildIcon(newIcon: Icon.Icon, ImageID: number)
	local IconInstance = newIcon:getInstance("IconSpot") :: Frame
	local newImage = newIcon:getInstance("IconImage") :: ImageLabel

	local newImageFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
	newImageFrame.Name = "newImageFrame"
	newImageFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
	newImageFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -45, 0, 3)
	newImageFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	newImageFrame.Parent = IconInstance

	newImage.Name = "newImage"
	newImage.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. ImageID
	newImage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	newImage.Parent = newImageFrame
end

function Stylized:setChildOutline(newIcon: Icon.Icon, parent: Icon.Icon, outlineColor: Color3?): UIStroke
	local IconInstance = newIcon:getInstance("IconSpot") :: Frame

	local Outline = (IconInstance:FindFirstChild("IconOutline") or Instance.new("UIStroke")) :: UIStroke
	Outline.Name = "IconOutline"
	Outline.Color = outlineColor or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	Outline.Thickness = 1
	Outline.Transparency = 1
	Outline.Enabled = false
	Outline.Parent = IconInstance:WaitForChild("GlowFrame", 5) or IconInstance

	parent:bindEvent("selected", function()
		Outline.Enabled = true
		TweenService:Create(Outline, TweenInfo.new(0.6), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
		task.wait(0.2)
	end)

	parent:bindEvent("deselected", function()
		Outline.Enabled = false
		TweenService:Create(Outline, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait()
	end)

	return Outline
end

function Stylized:setChildGleam(newIcon: Icon.Icon, parent: Icon.Icon, glowColor: Color3?, fadeTrans: {Start: number, End: number}?): UIGradient
	local IconInstance = newIcon:getInstance("IconSpot") :: Frame

	local newGlow = (IconInstance:FindFirstChild("GlowFrame") or createGlowFrame(glowColor)) :: Frame
	local Glow = newGlow:FindFirstChild("Glow") :: UIGradient

	if glowColor then
		Glow.Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, glowColor),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(0, 0, 0)),
		})
	end

	task.wait()

	newGlow.Visible = false
	newGlow.Parent = IconInstance
	newGlow.ZIndex = -1
	newGlow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, .99, 0)

	parent:bindEvent("selected", function()
		newGlow.Visible = true
		TweenService:Create(newGlow, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
	end)

	parent:bindEvent("deselected", function()
		TweenService:Create(newGlow, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		task.delay(0.25, function()
			newGlow.Visible = false
		end)
	end)

	local padding = IconInstance:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding") or Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.Parent = IconInstance
	padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 1)
	padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 1)
	padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 1)
	padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 1)

	return Glow
end

function Stylized:setBackground(_icon: Icon.Icon)
	-- reserved for future background styling
end

function Stylized:newListChild(parent: Icon.Icon): Icon.Icon
	local newChild = Icon.new()
	newChild:joinDropdown(parent)
	return newChild
end

function Stylized:bindIconToSounds(newIcon: Icon.Icon, oneClick: boolean?)
	if oneClick then
		newIcon:bindEvent("toggled", function()
			playSound(Config.Sounds.Click.SoundId)
		end)
	else
		newIcon:bindEvent("selected", function()
			playSound(Config.Sounds.Selected.SoundId)
		end)
		newIcon:bindEvent("deselected", function()
			playSound(Config.Sounds.Deselected.SoundId)
		end)
	end

	newIcon:bindEvent("viewingStarted", function()
		playSound(Config.Sounds.View.SoundId)
	end)
end

function Stylized:toggleCoreGui(coreGuiType: Enum.CoreGuiType, enabled: boolean)
	StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(coreGuiType, enabled)
end

return Stylized
